pair_note: Observed-only predecessor pair; physical ordering valid. Third recent non-zero post-reanchor pair confirms tens-of-seconds useful work is dominated by boundary idle cost.

decision.reason: Observed 12s useful work versus 822s idle yields 1.44% utilization. Boundary-cost sensitivity and prior clean 105s evidence both support extending same-wake useful work while safe. Scheduler-jitter handling was not changed. Continuation was secured before durable-state write.

measurement_guard.rule: work_end_time must be an observed completed-work timestamp at or before the state write; active_work_sec must represent completed useful work only
